summary: Preserve activated MinerPass level and difficulty rules through the quote-disabled consensus path
details: When quotes are disabled, miner and validator now use the level and difficulty factor already checked against the BTC-height-selected profile contract. They no longer recalculate those values with a fixed v1 formula after verification.
The existing public v1 formulas and identities are unchanged. No new production schema, state machine, formula or activation is enabled, and no dataset rebuild or network reset is required.

Explicitly scoped regtest builds exercise real Core/Ord/BH/indexer/Geth upgrades, independent reward verification, historical checkpoint recovery and repeated cross-boundary reorgs in new nightly and weekly shards. Ordinary binaries reject the test-only contracts.
